newsitem.title: USA: Conrail adding to steel shipment fleet.
newsitem.headline: Conrail adding to steel shipment fleet.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Friday it began receiving the first of 200 new covered CoilSHIELD-2 cars representing an investment of $13 million this week.
These cars will be added to the current fleet of 700 CoilSHIELD cars, which are dedicated to the steel industry for handling high quality sheet steel products.

Manufactured by Thrall Manufacturing in Chicago Heights, Illinois, the cars began joining the Conrail fleet this week, with 100 of the 200 to be delivered by May 19. The second 100 CoilSHIELD-2 cars will be added in July.
